lines.text: Ahh... the dust of green dreams. Long years, little forager.
You walk toward the Hollow King. You will need to walk where the sun is thinner.
Take my glass. It steps between the world and its shadow.
Use it in the grove: the Hollow mirrors this place. What is lost here sleeps there.
The Hollow is thick with his soldiers. The cape and the gloves you need are there.
The grove sings again! Go home, child. The rain has.
